# Conduit-Summit

A modern graphical user interface application built with R Shiny, providing an intuitive and user-friendly experience for managing and interacting with metaproteomic data processed by [Conduit-Ascent](https://github.com/baynec2/conduit-ascent).

## Features

- Modern and intuitive user interface
- Interactive data visualization
- Real-time data processing
- Easy-to-use controls and navigation
- Responsive design

## Prerequisites

Before you begin, ensure you have the following installed:
- R (version 4.0.0 or higher)
- RStudio (recommended for development)

Better instructions will be added soon

## Installation

1. Clone the repository:

```bash, eval = FALSE
git clone https://github.com/baynec2/conduit-GUI.git
cd conduit-GUI
```

2. Install required R packages: (To be updated this is a placeholder)

```r, eval = FALSE
install.packages(c("shiny", "shinydashboard", "tidyverse", "plotly"))
```

## Running the Application

To run the Shiny app locally:

1. Open the project in RStudio
2. Open the `app.R` file
3. Click 'Run App' in RStudio, or run:

```r, eval = FALSE
shiny::runApp()
```

## Development

The application structure follows R Shiny best practices:
- `app.R`: Main application file
- `R/`: Global variables and functions
- `ui.R`: User interface components
- `server.R`: Server-side logic
- `www/`: Static assets (CSS, JavaScript, images)
